note: Upson County park on the Flint River, ~10 mi W of Thomaston (700 Sprewell Bluff Rd). River Ridge Campground: RV sites with fire ring and picnic table (most back-in, overlooking the river), cabins, primitive sites, bathhouse. Boat ramp, 12+ mi of trails; park open 7 AM to dark. --Claude
